name: Sonomura Madoka
source:
A first-year student who is reserved and introverted, possessing a quiet, caring personality. She also has a slight fear of men.

Due to certain circumstances, she has feelings for Itsuki, but she is unable to take the initiative and merely watches from afar. That alone makes her stand out, but her admiration for Kyou and her aversion to Iori make her truly unique within the school.

She is also one of the few girls who are not swayed by Naoya, and in that sense, she can be considered unusual still. Perhaps because she is aware of this, she has a somewhat self-deprecating side.

[Translated from [url=https://www.light.gr.jp/light/products/imilover/iori/character/madoka.html]Official Site[/url]]
